title: Drew Streib - Servers and NAO
speaker: Drew Streib
description:
This talk is from the 2016 Roguelike Celebration: https://roguelike.club/event.html, re-uploaded 2021.

Drew is the owner of nethack.alt.org, the host of nethackwiki.com, and the author of dgamelaunch (the frontend for most public Nethack and Nethack variant servers these days). He will talk about the role of public servers for roguelikes and will field questions about NAO.

chapters.title: A Brief History of Public Servers (indulge the wistful thoughts) Original servers were (are?) universities, shared "nix systems, but not really "public .
